verdict.rationale: Pipedream exposes a REST API for creating workflows, managing event sources and subscriptions, plus a CLI (`pd deploy`, `pd dev`) for deploying/developing components, and Connect/MCP APIs and SDKs for auth and tool calls — covering most core UI actions programmatically. However, there's no explicit documentation confirming full parity (e.g., visual workflow-builder specific features, test-event UI actions) is entirely API-accessible, and no independent/hands-on confirmation of complete UI-API equivalence. Missing for 10: explicit parity statement or evidence covering all UI-only features (e.g., visual builder editing, test-event triggering) via API, and independent corroboration of full API coverage.
